focus: Los Angeles, the San Fernando Valley, and West LA
intro: Banks and shipping stores in Los Angeles often stop taking notarizations by late afternoon, which is why people looking after work or on a weekend come up empty. This first Los Angeles page lists notaries that publicly advertise evening, weekend, 24-hour, or mobile service in the city and nearby areas — including the San Fernando Valley, West LA, and one Beverly Hills storefront, clearly labeled. It is not a complete county inventory. Every hour, fee, and service flag comes from the business’s own website and is dated when we last checked it. If we could not verify a detail, we left it out. Call or text to confirm availability before you book.

listings.name: LA Notary On Call
listings.area: Los Angeles County (mobile); in-person appointments near Glendale

hours.notes: The site lists mobile appointments 24/7 throughout Los Angeles County, subject to availability and manual acceptance. Scheduled in-person appointments near Glendale are Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–4:00 PM.

listings.visitNotes: The services page lists hospital, assisted-living, and jail or detention facility visits. Jail visits need an individual quote and depend on facility rules.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-18: an after-hours fee of +$20 applies after 9:00 PM only; the pricing page says there is no weekend surcharge and no same-day surcharge. Jail and detention facility visits start at $200 plus California’s notarial fee. Travel fees depend on distance and are confirmed before the appointment is accepted.

listings.name: CPC Mobile Notary
listings.area: Los Angeles County and Orange County (mobile)

hours.notes: Published hours: Monday–Friday 6 PM–12 AM; Saturday–Sunday 24/7 by arrangement. The site says same-day availability, 7 days a week.

listings.visitNotes: The homepage says the notary travels to homes, offices, hospitals, care facilities, and correctional facilities.
listings.feeNotes: No fee schedule published on the homepage we checked. The site says additional travel fees may apply beyond its standard radius.

listings.name: Professional Mobile Notary Public (Pro Mobile Notary LA)
listings.area: All areas of Los Angeles County (mobile)

hours.notes: The homepage advertises 24-hour, seven-days-a-week mobile service, including weekends and holidays.

listings.visitNotes: The homepage lists home, office, and hospital visits, and jail signings.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-18: rates depend on location, hour of service, and service requested, plus California’s $15 per notarized signature. Service past the first hour is $50 per additional hour. Real estate signings are quoted separately.

listings.name: Notary Public LA County
listings.area: Los Angeles County and Orange County (mobile)

hours.notes: Published hours: mobile notary 24/7; office visits Monday–Thursday 10 AM–5 PM. The office address is not published on the homepage.

listings.visitNotes: The homepage lists homes, offices, hospitals, care facilities, and jail visits. Spanish-language appointments are offered.
listings.feeNotes: No fee schedule published on the homepage we checked. The site says the total is quoted before the notary leaves.

listings.name: Cachet Notary
listings.area: Greater Los Angeles, including West Hollywood, Beverly Hills, Hollywood, Mid-City, and Downtown (mobile)

hours.notes: The homepage says regular hours plus evenings and weekends by appointment, with same-day appointments 7 days. It does not publish clock times.

listings.visitNotes: The homepage lists homes, hospitals, offices, and care facilities. Jail visits were not mentioned on the page we checked.
listings.feeNotes: No fee schedule published on the homepage we checked.

listings.name: PandA Notary
listings.area: West LA (mobile); offices in Century City and Canoga Park
listings.address: 2029 Century Park East, Los Angeles, CA (Century City office; by appointment)

hours.notes: The services page says by appointment, 7 days a week, with same-day mobile visits often available. Loan signings are offered evenings and weekends. It does not publish clock times.

listings.visitNotes: The services page lists bedside notarizations at hospitals, rehab centers, and senior living. Jail visits were not mentioned on the page we checked.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-18: in-office notarization at the Century City office is $15 per signature with no travel fee. Mobile pricing is on a separate page we did not check.

listings.name: VIP Notary Services
listings.area: Santa Monica, West Los Angeles, Century City, Beverly Hills, and other Southern California areas (mobile)

hours.notes: The 24/7 page says the service is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including Sundays and some holidays, by appointment only. Contact info lists Santa Monica, CA 90403.

listings.visitNotes: Hospital and jail visits are not described on the page we checked.
listings.feeNotes: No fee schedule published; the page says to contact the firm for a free quote.

listings.name: GoSignNotary
listings.area: Los Angeles County, including Sherman Oaks, Burbank, Santa Monica, Woodland Hills, and Encino (mobile)

hours.notes: The pricing page lists after-hours appointments after 8 PM, based on availability. Regular hours and weekend availability are not published on the page we checked.

listings.visitNotes: The pricing page lists hospital, care facility, and jail/detention visits.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-18: $15 per signature; travel $65 up to 25 miles; after-hours (after 8 PM) $75–$100 depending on availability; hospital visit $100; care facility visit $85; jail/detention visit $180.

listings.name: SF Valley Mobile Notary Services

hours.notes: Published hours: Monday–Friday evenings 6–9 PM and Saturday–Sunday 9 AM–3:30 PM, by appointment only.

listings.visitNotes: The homepage lists homes, hospitals, care facilities, and attorneys’ offices in the Valley. Jail visits were not mentioned.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-18: a $30 booking fee secures the appointment and is applied to the total; it is non-refundable unless cancelled at least 24 hours ahead.

listings.name: Chapen’s Signature Pro
listings.area: North Hollywood, the San Fernando Valley, and nearby areas such as Glendale, Pasadena, Los Feliz, and Silver Lake (mobile and office)

hours.notes: Published regular hours, by appointment. The site says after-hours, same-day, and emergency appointments may be available on request, with additional fees; the booking form offers an evening (5–9 PM) time preference.

listings.visitNotes: The site lists home, office, hospital, care facility, and jail/detention facility appointments.
listings.feeNotes: Final quote confirmed before the appointment. After-hours and emergency requests may carry additional fees.

listings.name: All Access Notary
listings.area: San Fernando Valley, Studio City, Sherman Oaks, North Hollywood, Burbank, Glendale, Hollywood, Beverly Hills (mobile)

hours.notes: Published hours: Monday–Saturday 11 AM–7 PM; Sunday by appointment. The site says after hours are available upon request.

listings.visitNotes: The homepage says mobile services come to your home, office, or hospital. Jail visits were not mentioned.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-18: $15 per notarized signature for acknowledgments and jurats; travel fees vary by location; 15-minute grace period, then $10 per 15 minutes of waiting.

listings.name: Print It (Van Nuys)
listings.area: Van Nuys office; mobile within roughly 40 miles
listings.address: 14545 Friar St Ste 100, Van Nuys, CA 91411

hours.notes: Published office hours; walk-ins welcome 7 days. English and Spanish.

listings.visitNotes: Walk-in office. The notary page also lists mobile visits to homes, hospitals, nursing homes, and correctional facilities.

listings.name: Mail Boxes Times (Beverly Hills)
listings.area: Beverly Hills storefront; traveling notary across Los Angeles County

hours.notes: Published store hours. A notary is on site during all business hours, walk-ins welcome. The page also offers traveling notary service during non-business hours or by appointment.

listings.visitNotes: This storefront is in Beverly Hills, next to Los Angeles. Evenings are via the traveling notary by appointment, not the storefront.
listings.feeNotes: As listed on 2026-11-18: $15 per signature in store.
